title.narrative: Strengthen DOTS Strategy within the Framework of the New Strategy: Stop TB - Guatemala (01-Jul-2016-30-Jun-2019)

description.narrative: Guatemala, Tuberculosis, Ministry of Health and Social Assistance of the Republic of Guatemala (MSPAS)This program has the following goals: Reduce estimated incidence of TB all forms by 12% in the next three years compared to 2014. Reduce estimated incidence of TB BK+ by 12% in the next three years compared to 2014. Reduce mortality due to tuberculosis by 20% in the next three years compared to 2014. The objectives of this program are: Improve the success of treatment of patients with TB and MDR TB with patient-centered support. Reduce the burden of TB in people living with HIV and reduce the burden of HIV in people affected by TB. Strengthen early detection and diagnosis of TB and MDR TB focused on patient care.. Strengthen technical program management of the NTP. Strengthen the information and reporting cases of TB system and vital records
